scope.not_done: No native retrieval, training, unit test, target lookup, raw CRM/private identity/contact read, label correction, new source admission, closed-set opening, downstream model change or paid compute. No source chosen from the 19 misses. This is a proposal, not authorization to execute it.
scope.resources: Mac M4 Pro and CATNAT only; no external spending. Corpus/index preparation is distinct from per-query serving cost.

known_evidence_not_new_measurement.population: 405 SIREN groups / 295 communes. ALL526 has been consumed for architecture/source selection. Zero explicit supervised TRAIN overlap does not restore pristine status or establish full encoder OOF.
known_evidence_not_new_measurement.current_engine_from_parent_handoff: Frozen EmbeddingGemma2 V6 best1000; national lexical and query-specific geographic universes; native learned linear score with 58 coefficients / 51 base-feature interactions and typed parent context. A new model's name is not a new evidence source.
known_evidence_not_new_measurement.V157: Two of the 19 current exact misses have raw BANO geography worst-rank <=50. Seven have supported own XY plus BANO, five of those seven have best-rank >100; five other supported own-XY misses have no compatible BANO points; five have missing/unsupported own XY and two protected cases remain skipped. This is component potential, not retrieval recall or a proven admission cause.
known_evidence_not_new_measurement.source_limit_from_parent_handoff: Whole-source SIGLE/direct ACTIVITY/corporate BODACC-administration diagnostics produced zero novel positive context for the current misses. This reduces support for repeating those same source/model ideas, but does not establish information-theoretic impossibility.
known_evidence_not_new_measurement.gap: On this consumed panel, >=99.2% would require at least 522/526 exact hits, hence >=15 net additional hits from 507. Even reaching that count would not validate national generalization or necessarily pass the confidence gate. No method below is claimed to supply those 15 gains.

primary_sources.title: Sparkly: A Simple yet Surprisingly Strong TF/IDF Blocker for Entity Matching
primary_sources.verified_evidence: The paper evaluates Lucene TF/IDF top-k blocking and automatic attribute/tokenizer selection using discriminativeness. Its large-scale runs use distributed AWS clusters; WDC 26M lacks complete gold for recall. Results justify a strong indexed lexical baseline, not SIRETO recall or Mac SLO transfer.
primary_sources.SIRETO_inference: Retain lexical fields and direct top100 collection. Explore label-free view ambiguity as a limited native scoring feature, not Sparkly Auto's unrestricted configuration search or unions of per-view pools.

primary_sources.title: Faster Top-k Document Retrieval Using Block-Max Indexes
primary_sources.verified_evidence: The paper develops safe early termination using block score bounds for disjunctive queries, preserving exhaustive top-k results. It explicitly shows that a naive substitution of local block maxima into WAND is not sufficient for correctness.
primary_sources.SIRETO_inference: Exact bound-based skipping may reduce scoring work but cannot improve recall of an unchanged score. Applying it to signed interactions, typed relations and query-specific geography requires new valid bounds and equivalence evidence; merely invoking WAND is insufficient.

primary_sources.title: Collective Entity Resolution in Relational Data
primary_sources.verified_evidence: Attribute and relational information jointly improve resolution in the paper's relational reference graphs. Its task is collective clustering/resolution, not national SIRET retrieval with an absolute cap100.
primary_sources.SIRETO_inference: Relations can supply evidence distinct from literal names. Preserve parent, site and relation role/date rather than merging linked entities or treating a group/customer name as an own-site alias. Bounded typed evidence in a native score is a project hypothesis, not a reproduction of collective clustering.

primary_sources.title: A Theory for Record Linkage
primary_sources.verified_evidence: Evidence is compared through match versus nonmatch comparison distributions. The paper allows insufficient-evidence decisions and warns that violated independence assumptions may destroy probabilistic weight interpretations.
primary_sources.SIRETO_inference: Chance agreement and ambiguity matter. Parent/site/geo evidence is dependent, so a small regularized reliability correction is preferable to claiming independent likelihood probabilities. No abstention or insufficient-evidence segment may remove a query from the primary retrieval denominator.

primary_sources.title: SC-Block: Supervised Contrastive Blocking within Entity Resolution Pipelines
primary_sources.verified_evidence: Supervised contrastive embeddings and nearest-neighbour blocking are evaluated, including pipeline runtime at 99.5% pair completeness. Neither an absolute100 SIRET cap nor the SIRETO missing-identity regime is established.
primary_sources.SIRETO_inference: Contrastive blockers are a legitimate later comparison when representation evidence exists; the reported completeness does not guarantee our exact@100.

primary_sources.title: SC-Block++: A Blocking Algorithm Based on Adaptive Flood Regularization
primary_sources.verified_evidence: Adaptive flooding extends SC-Block on three product datasets. The published procedure estimates20 auxiliary networks,20epochs each, with last-three-layer reinitialization from a base auxiliary model that has seen the union of training data.
primary_sources.SIRETO_inference: Not an immediate economical Mac experiment. Partial layer reinitialization is not proof of clean outer-fold non-exposure; it cannot be copied as our full encoder-OOF guarantee. Regularization cannot manufacture an undocumented brand-to-operator relation.

three_applicable_methods_contrast.application: Memory-mapped lexical postings plus compact numeric/spatial blocks, exact admissible bounds for the same unified native score, one heap of at most100 SIRET. Missing-geo records retain access through other views; no hard commune, active-only or fixed-radius identity filter.
three_applicable_methods_contrast.budget_and_failure: No national dense token-vector rebuild. Begin with bounded sequential blocks if an index is too costly. Signed coefficients require appropriate lower/upper feature bounds; interactions, float precision and tie policy must be preserved. If safe bounds cannot be established, use exact scanning or STOP on SLO; no approximate prepool disguised as indexing.
three_applicable_methods_contrast.proof: Before labels, compare output hashes to the frozen exhaustive scorer on a predetermined label-free query suite spanning dense communes, weak inputs, many relation targets and missing geography. Record skipped blocks, evaluated rows and cost. Equality proves implementation fidelity only, not new generalization.

three_applicable_methods_contrast.method: Typed multi-view reliability and ambiguity within the native score
three_applicable_methods_contrast.purpose: Potential recall gain from evidence competition rather than more raw text
three_applicable_methods_contrast.application: Own-site names/addresses, parent names, dated typed relations and own geography remain distinct. Use full-corpus label-free evidence collision counts and source/missingness indicators to learn a small native correction before the sole top100 collector. Do not add blanket headquarters/active bonuses, copy parent addresses, reserve50 geographic candidates or merge five top100 lists.
three_applicable_methods_contrast.budget_and_failure: Keep the encoder frozen for the first limited hypothesis; compact precomputed evidence statistics and a small regularized correction are plausible on Mac. Novelty is conditional: first compare the proposed statistics with existing51features/58interactions without labels; if already represented equivalently, do not relaunch a relabelled duplicate experiment.
three_applicable_methods_contrast.limits: A global monotonic calibration of the final scalar score cannot change top100 membership. Only relative view reliability/interactions can affect admission. A small geographically plausible target does not prove that suppressing stronger rivals is correct for unseen queries.

three_applicable_methods_contrast.method: Grouped contrastive representation with ambiguity-safe supervision
three_applicable_methods_contrast.purpose: Later representation improvement, only if missing-evidence diagnosis does not dominate
three_applicable_methods_contrast.application: Separate site exact identity from parent/entity-name supervision; do not turn identical ambiguous text into falsely decisive negatives. Any future outer encoder starts from unexposed base/official-only initialization; inner selection and checkpoint control are grouped.
three_applicable_methods_contrast.budget_and_failure: National embeddings/index rebuild and nested outer training have real Mac time/storage cost. SC-Block++20auxiliary-network procedure is not selected. Keep this direction deferred rather than predicting gains from lower contrastive loss.
three_applicable_methods_contrast.limits: Does not create absent official brand/operator bridges, resolve protected identities or guarantee exact site selection. A benchmark's99.5% pair completeness is not SIRETO99.2%@100.

recommended_one_next_direction.name: PREFLIGHT_THEN_TYPED_AMBIGUITY_NATIVE_RELIABILITY
recommended_one_next_direction.decision: ONE bounded hypothesis: improve evidence competition using typed, ambiguity-aware reliability in the existing national native score; make score-equivalent indexing the engineering SLO companion. Do not start another dense training campaign or source scan selected by the19misses.
recommended_one_next_direction.why: Existing whole-source relation additions have measured gains, but recent repeated channels add no new support. V157 exposes a small potential competition failure and widespread missing/weak geography. A constrained correction is falsifiable and much cheaper than national re-encoding; it has no evidence-backed promise of reaching99.2%.
bounded_novel_features_proposal: Label-free number of corpus entities sharing the normalized evidence value/token signature, separately for own-site and parent views; version and smoothing fixed before training.
Own-geo compatibility/availability plus full-index count of plausible spatial distractors under a preregistered geometry rule, not a target-dependent radius or per-query chosen BANO point.
Published typed relation fanout and evidence role/date/support availability, without using SIREN/SIRET magnitude, identity embeddings or CRM alias tables.
Explicit missingness/unsupported-own-geo and own-site versus parent-supported provenance, not reconstructed coordinates or an address borrowed from a related company.
recommended_one_next_direction.scope_lock: At most these four statistic families, no new sources/checkpoint, no per-query clauses, one regularized low-capacity correction family. These are proposed specifications, not inferred absent features. Static redundancy audit precedes and may cancel the experiment.
recommended_one_next_direction.collection: Compile the baseline coefficients and the correction into one serving score over the complete national eligible corpus. Only a single native collector emits <=100unique SIRET; no fixed2000/500, per-view50/100 pools, oracle union, downstream rerank or label-side admission. Internal index blocks are traversal units, not candidate pools.

missing_evidence_vs_score_competition_pr.design: Preregister on all future evaluation queries, not the19misses. Generation records source/component availability and corpus collision summaries without labels. Entire outputs and bindings are sealed first; a separate official label-side custodian attributes EVERY miss from frozen corpus/evidence and already generated scores. Attribution never feeds candidate generation or recipe selection.
ordered_taxonomy: OFFICIAL_CATALOG_ABSENT: target absent from the authorized as-of corpus; remains an end-to-end error.
SOURCE_TO_INDEX_GAP: authorized own/typed evidence exists in the frozen official source but is not represented in the index; distinguish from corpus absence and prohibit target-only patching.
ELIGIBILITY_OR_TRAVERSAL_LOSS: represented target cannot be visited because of an exclusion or an invalid/approximate bound. Safe exact indexing should contribute zero such losses.

NO_DISCRIMINATIVE_AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE: source/index provides no tested bridge or missing/unsupported own location; absence is scoped to the frozen representation, not a claim that no public evidence exists.

REPRESENTATION_AMBIGUITY: equal or observationally indistinguishable allowed evidence across many sites/entities; report equivalence-class size and best/worst ranks under the frozen representation. More than100symmetric candidates is a representation-level cap conflict, not proof that future evidence cannot resolve it.

SCORE_COMPETITION: represented eligible target has informative evidence yet is behind competing candidates under the unified score. Component rank alone is not causal proof; compare the one globally specified correction on all queries and report both rescued and newly lost targets.

UNATTRIBUTED_OR_PROTECTED: evidence insufficient for the finer attribution, or privacy-protected identity not inspected. Retain all-human denominator and publish counts; no inferred label-error category.
missing_evidence_vs_score_competition_pr.causal_limit: Development may include only preregistered inner-fold global ablations holding the corpus fixed. An improvement from score changes with unchanged index supports competition correction; an index-only equivalent result proves fidelity, not recall gain. Any post-label target diagnostics are explanatory only. No oracle maximum across channels or winning recipe per query.
missing_evidence_vs_score_competition_pr.labels: Independent humans annotate prospectively blind to predictions under one fixed labeling policy. Existing labels remain unchanged. Exact and operational results stay separate; alternate operational sites cannot erase exact misses.

This is a proposed minimum useful improvement, not a power result or forecast; confirmatory architecture acceptance also requires the unchanged absolute contractual gates.

Commit isolated milestones and cite them in root-owned handover.md.

bottom_line: The defensible next research direction is a small, typed, ambiguity-aware native scoring hypothesis with exact indexed execution, followed by one clean future test. Existing measurements do not support99.2%, a blanket geography/seat repair, further targeted source additions or a promise that retraining will recover the missing identities.
